title: PolicyEvaluationTrace
description: Ordered trace showing how the policy gate reached a final policy decision.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation trace.

run_id.description: Run that this trace belongs to.

action_id.description: Action proposal evaluated by this trace.

evaluated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the action was evaluated.

rules_evaluated.description: Ordered policy rules evaluated for this action.

final_result.description: Final policy result reached by the rule chain.

deterministic_fingerprint.description: Stable SHA-256 fingerprint matching the related policy decision.
